data.one_liner: String validation and sanitization for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of functions to validate common string patterns such as emails, URLs, IPs, and more. It also offers sanitization helpers to clean input strings.
use_when: You need quick, reusable validation logic without external dependencies.
You want to validate user input in forms or APIs.
You need to sanitize strings before processing or storing them.
avoid_when: You require advanced form building or UI integration; a dedicated form library would be better.
You need localization or internationalization of validation messages.
You need to generate validation code automatically.
strengths: Up-to-date regexes and edge‑case handling (e.g., email backtracking fix).
weaknesses: Limited to string validation; no UI components.
Not a form builder, just helper functions.

alternatives.name: validators
alternatives.why_pick_it: Same functionality, older version; use if you need compatibility with older Dart SDKs.
